title: Token name format
description: Export token names in the selected case.

title: Class name prefix
description: Prefix for generated Dart class names (e.g. 'App' produces AppColors, AppTextStyles, etc.).

title: Show token descriptions
description: Show the token description as a documentation comment (///) for every exported token.

title: Show file disclaimer
description: A message explaining that the file was automatically generated will appear at the top of all generated files.

default:
This file was generated automatically by Supernova.io and should not be changed manually.
To modify the format or content of this file, please contact your design system team.
title: Disclaimer message
description: The disclaimer text to include at the top of generated files.

title: Generate empty style files
description: Generate empty style files for token types that have no tokens, instead of omitting them.

title: Generate barrel file
description: Generate a barrel file that re-exports all generated style files.

title: Barrel filename
description: The name of the barrel file that will be generated.

title: Path to base style files
description: All base (non-themed) files will be written to this directory relative to export root.

title: Style file names
description: Name of each file that will be generated, grouped by token type.

title: Theme export format
description: Control how themes are exported in the generated files.

separateFiles.label: Separate files per theme
separateFiles.description: Generate a separate file for each selected theme in subdirectories

applyDirectly.label: Apply themes directly
applyDirectly.description: Apply selected themes directly to token values (single set of files)

title: Export base values
description: Base token values will be exported along with themes.

title: Export only themed tokens
description: Theme files will only include tokens that have different values from the base value.
